description: Raindrop.io is a bookmark manager for saving, organizing, and searching links and web content. It also provides AI-agent access to a user's bookmark library through an MCP server.
summary: Raindrop.io exposes a REST API at `https://api.raindrop.io/rest/v1` and an MCP server at `https://api.raindrop.io/rest/v2/ai/mcp`; both use bearer access tokens, and the MCP server also supports interactive OAuth in compatible MCP clients.
